title: Smart Farming
description: A lightweight vanilla-friendly farming QoL mod that improves harvesting, replanting, and overall crop management.
body:
# Smart Farming

Smart Farming is a lightweight quality-of-life Minecraft mod designed to improve farming without changing the vanilla feel of the game.

The mod focuses on making crop harvesting and replanting faster, smoother, and less repetitive while staying balanced for survival gameplay and multiplayer servers.

## Features

- Automatic crop replanting
- Faster harvesting workflow
- Vanilla-friendly mechanics
- Lightweight and optimized
- Server-friendly behavior
- Simple and intuitive farming improvements

## How It Works

When harvesting fully grown crops, Smart Farming automatically handles repetitive farming actions to reduce unnecessary clicking and make large farms easier to maintain.

The mod is designed to feel like a natural extension of vanilla Minecraft rather than a complete farming overhaul.

## Compatibility

- Fabric
- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Lightweight client-side friendly implementation
- Works well in survival worlds and multiplayer environments

## Design Goals

Smart Farming aims to:

- Reduce repetitive farming actions
- Keep farming fast and convenient
- Preserve vanilla gameplay balance
- Stay lightweight with minimal performance impact
